hero.title: File:UT Tower Shooting Memorial Austin.jpg
hero.description: Pink granite memorial to those killed at the University of Texas tower shooting in Austin, Texas, United States on August 1, 1966. The Tower Memorial Enhancement Group placed the memorial with approval from the University of Texas Division of Diversity and Community Engagement. Cook-Walden Funeral Homes and Cemeteries paid for the memorial and bench to honor Charles Walden, the former owner of Cook-Walden, who was present during the shooting and used his company's hearses as ambulances.
categories: Monuments and memorials at the University of Texas at Austin

gallery.filename: Texas Tower Sniper Glass Bullet Hole Bettmann Archive cropped 2 August 1966.jpg
gallery.title: File:Texas Tower Sniper Glass Bullet Hole Bettmann Archive cropped 2 August 1966.jpg
gallery.description: The window of Sheftall's Jewelry store at 2268 Guadalupe St. was shattered by a bullet fired by sniper Charles Whitman during the University of Texas Tower Shooting.  The area around the store known locally as "The Drag" became a shooting zone, with at least seven gunshot victims taking cover inside the store until an ambulance could arrive.
